prompts.label: B 动漫烈焰
prompts.prompt:
Use the provided selection board ONLY as a style reference for panel B, labelled 动漫烈焰 (top middle). Produce an animation sprite atlas containing ONLY this anime flame effect, no dog, no character, no keyboard, no labels, no typography, no icons, no background objects. EXACTLY 2 columns x 2 rows, four equally sized frames on a square canvas, genuine transparent alpha background.
Each cell contains a complete matching flame effect for a seated desktop dog to be composited in front later: upward orange-red flame tongues on both sides, golden-yellow inner flame cores, bright vermilion outside layers, clean cel-painted anime silhouettes. Gentle asymmetry. A low band of flame at the bottom connects two taller rising sides. Keep the CENTER largely TRANSPARENT, making a broad opening for the pet. No closed ring, no explosion, no smoke. Just a few small orange sparks near sides.
All four cells have identical scale, same bottom baseline and generous margins, all sparks and flames fully within each cell. Four successive frames of one smooth loop: tips lean left, rise and curl, drift right, settle toward first pose; only moderate changes, preserve overall mass and position. Paint this as the exact orange/red style seen BEHIND the dog in panel B, not the other five variants. Saturated clean shapes remain legible at 200px. Main flame tongues should be visually solid with antialiased edges, not a foggy faint glow. Fill roughly 80% of each cell width and 75% of height, no huge blank upper half. Do NOT draw the dog from the reference. True transparent background, not a checkerboard picture.

prompts.label: F 彩虹能量焰
prompts.prompt:
Use the provided comparison board ONLY as the visual style reference for panel F, labelled 彩虹能量焰 (bottom right). Create a production animation sprite atlas containing ONLY that soft pastel rainbow flame effect, no dog, no character, no keyboard, no letters, no labels or frame borders. EXACTLY 2 columns x 2 rows of equal cells, four sequential frames of one looping effect, on a genuinely transparent alpha background.
Each frame is a complete effect that will be BEHIND a seated white dog later: elegant flowing flame ribbons on the left and right sides, lavender and rose pink rising tips, peach-gold inner light, turquoise/aqua lower side tongues, a few tiny warm star sparkles near the outer edges. Main ribbons have gently curved clear luminous pastel surfaces and tapering tips, soft gradient interiors but crisp readable silhouette; do not make the whole artwork barely visible. A low thin flowing base links the sides; most of the CENTER stays TRANSPARENT for the dog. No filled circular aura, no opaque disk, no smoke, no solid black or white background, no checkerboard pattern. Keep the delicate joyful magical flame character of F, do not use the jagged red-orange style B.
Four successive animation poses: drifting ribbons rise and lean, curls lengthen, tips shift to opposite side, then settle toward first frame. Subtle coherent evolution, consistent root position, scale, brightness, palette across all four. Same bottom baseline. Keep main flame width about 80% of each cell and height 75%, with generous clear margins for sparks; none cross cell boundaries. No massive empty top half. Strong shape differences from orange anime flames: soft broad S-curves and airy iridescent ribbons with small detached sparkles. TRANSPARENT background, no pet repeated from the reference.
